name: Boku to Kanojo no Kojin Lesson 2
source:
[i]"......I can't sleep."[/i]

Asakura Shinji was at his wit’s end.

Night after night, sleep escaped him.
Even lying in bed with his eyes shut was no good.
Instead, he’d get sleepy during the day at school, always in a haze...

One evening, on a whim, he ended up going out into the town when everyone was asleep――

[i]“You shouldn’t be out at this hour! Go home and get some sleep!”[/i]

Shinji unexpectedly bumped into his homeroom teacher, Hagino Umi.
Concerned, Umi listened to Shinji’s insomnia problem.

[i]“You need to make the most of each day. Then, you should be able to sleep soundly.”[/i]

Though he received this advice, Shinji didn’t know where to start. After all, he spent his days in a daze, only coming alive when the sun went down...

[i]"Hmm... well, Sensei would love to help you in that case.... but..."[/i]

Umi wanted to help, but her position as a teacher couldn't exactly condone such nighttime strolling behavior.
Shinji, understanding this, ventured out again another night, not expecting much.

There, he encountered――Umi-sensei, in a different outfit, pretending to be someone else.

[i]“Umm… I-I’m Ogino Miu!”[/i]

Thus began a string of special nights, just the teacher (?) and her student, spending precious time together, a soothing balm for his troubled heart――

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/sensei2/story.html]official website[/url]]

Also features the after story for the previous heroine [url=/c100752]Tsukimori Misaki[/url].
translation:
[i]“……我睡不着。”[/i]

朝仓慎司已经无计可施了。

一夜又一夜，他无法入睡。
就算是躺在床上闭着眼睛也不好。
相反，他白天在学校就会犯困，总是处于昏昏沉沉的状态……

有一天晚上，他一时兴起，趁着大家都睡着的时候，到了小镇——

[i]“这个时间不应该出去！回家睡觉吧！”[/i]

真嗣意外地遇见了班主任萩野海美。
海关心地听着真嗣的失眠问题。

[i]“你需要充分利用每一天。然后，你应该能够睡个好觉。”[/i]

尽管收到了这个建议，真嗣还是不知道从哪里开始。毕竟，他这一天都是在发呆中度过的，直到太阳落山之后才活过来……

[i]“嗯……嗯，在这种情况下，老师很乐意帮助你……但是……”[/i]

海美想帮忙，但她作为老师的身份不能容忍这种夜间散步的行为。
真嗣明白了这一点，第二天晚上再次冒险出去，并没有抱太大期望。

在那里，他遇到了——穿着不同服装、假装成别人的海老师。

[i]“嗯……我、我是荻野美宇！”[/i]

就这样，一连串特别的夜晚开始了，只有老师（？）和她的学生，度过了宝贵的时光，抚慰着他不安的心——

[翻译编辑自[url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/sensei2/story.html]官网[/url]]

还收录了前任女主角的后续故事 [url=/c100752]月森美咲[/url]。
